fields.headline: FOURSOMES.
fields.body: Two against two, one ball a side. The format that tests a partnership.

fields.headline: ALTERNATE SHOTS.
fields.body: Partners hit alternate shots with one ball, tee shots included, until it is holed. Miss the green and your partner plays the chip.

fields.headline: HALF THE PAIR.
fields.body: The side plays off half the combined course handicaps, and shots are given off the difference between the two sides.

fields.headline: ONE CARD A SIDE.
fields.body: One score a hole for the pair. The blended handicap is worked out once, at the draw, and rounded once, so no side ever carries half a shot.
